2026_04_ARI_NYG.headline: Arizona’s possession-heavy attack meets a Giants defense protecting a backup-led offense
2026_04_ARI_NYG.paragraph1: Arizona arrives after Jacoby Brissett threw 52 passes in a narrow loss at San Francisco, with rookie Jeremiyah Love taking on a larger rushing and receiving role. New York, meanwhile, won its first game since Jaxson Dart’s season-ending knee injury by leaning on defense and four Dominic Zvada field goals. The matchup turns on whether the Giants can keep Arizona from sustaining long drives while their own offense avoids forcing the defense to carry another low-scoring game.
2026_04_ARI_NYG.model_rationale: Arizona’s ability to sustain drives and diversify through Love tests a Giants team currently leaning heavily on defense, making quarterback efficiency and field position central to the matchup.
